propositions: Four code-review criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must transition from advisory to blocking status at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50 respectively) based on code-v3 corpus validation.

Regression and error-handling criteria must be added as new base-reviewer dimension entries (not overlays) where only default_posture, block_threshold, and blocking_enabled are consulted by threshold resolution.

Three governance-pin tests must be updated to assert the new 7-member approved blocking set (security, secret-detection, high-critical-security, api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) instead of the previous 3-member set.
The packaged criteria_routing.json edits must land before RP-06 S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) captures its immutable CriteriaSnapshot golden baseline to preserve calibrated thresholds.
